main_text.p: æra, quam lignum, indubi-ratum Antiquis; explodit ho-die ipsis etiam triviis non ignotum experimentum. Et hinc Academiarum supellex non erunt vasta illa volumina, inepti centones, in quibus cæci disputant de coloribus, & pecorum ritu, in Veterum sententias abeunt Minores; sed telescopia, quibus è cælo remotissima quævis adducun-tur, nova sidera deteguntur, aliorum cornua, aliorum asperitates, quas longo intervallo dissimulant, veniunt, in conspectum, insuper herbarum & fruticum horti, Anatomica Theatra, Alembici, fornaces, Magnetes, aliaque id.
main_text.notes: The left edge strip shows fragments of the neighbouring page (show-through), not transcribed. The first word reads "æra" with a damaged initial letter, rendered as printed in the visible portion ("æra"). The word "id." is the catchword.
